verdict.rationale: The Team API explicitly supports managing users, locations, departments, and cards, and budgets can be allocated with auto-enforced controls, implying role/permission structuring across these dimensions. However, there is no first-party documentation detailing granular role-based permission configuration (e.g., custom roles, approval hierarchies) beyond the API's existence, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of this specific admin capability. Missing for 10: detailed docs on custom role definitions/permission levels, UI walkthrough of role management, and independent verification of granularity.
